tableDescription: Finance analytics table combining order line items with revenue, margin, return metrics, and dimensional attributes for business reporting.

columnDescriptions.count: Total order line items including returned ones.
columnDescriptions.net_revenue: Actual revenue retained after excluding returned items.
columnDescriptions.gross_margin_rate: Profit percentage per euro earned after item costs.
columnDescriptions.financial_return_rate: Percentage of total sales value lost to customer returns.
columnDescriptions.avg_order_value: Typical total spend per customer order.
columnDescriptions.gross_revenue: Total sales value before deducting returns.
columnDescriptions.gross_margin: Total profit after subtracting item costs from net revenue.
columnDescriptions.returned_revenue: Total sales value of returned items only.
columnDescriptions.order_item_id: Unique identifier for an individual order line item.
columnDescriptions.order_id: Identifier linking line items to a parent order.
columnDescriptions.status: Current fulfillment status of the order line item.
columnDescriptions.ordered_date: Timestamp when the order was placed.
columnDescriptions.delivered_date: Timestamp when the order was delivered.
columnDescriptions.is_returned: Flags whether this line item was returned.
columnDescriptions.is_delivered: Flags whether this line item was delivered.
columnDescriptions.products_category: Product category for grouping and filtering.
columnDescriptions.products_brand: Brand associated with the ordered product.
columnDescriptions.products_department: Department classification of the ordered product.
columnDescriptions.users_country: Country of the customer who placed the order.
columnDescriptions.users_state: State or region of the customer.
columnDescriptions.users_traffic_source: Marketing channel that acquired the customer.
columnDescriptions.orders_status: Overall status of the parent order.
columnDescriptions.dates_year: Year extracted from the order date.
columnDescriptions.dates_year_month: Year and month in YYYY-MM format.
columnDescriptions.dates_year_quarter: Year and quarter in YYYY-Qn format.
columnDescriptions.dates_is_weekend: Flags whether the order was placed on a weekend.
columnDescriptions.__user: Virtual column used for row-level security context.
columnDescriptions.__cubeJoinField: Virtual column used internally for cube joins.
